Implement durable runnable lease state machine (#155)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-53
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add provider-neutral runnable lease state, fence, evidence, release, and reacquisition contracts
    - evolve the current PostgreSQL projection with monotonic generations and immutable ordered transition events
    - serialize claims and reacquisitions on the same global capacity authority and return mutation-free capacity pending
    - document the A-E scenario, rollout order, and deferred lifecycle wiring
    
    ## Verification
    
    - cargo test -p codeon-tracker capacity_policy_tests
    - cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test migration_acceptance migration_reaches_latest_and_replays_without_changes -- --nocapture
